text:
aisha: Quick pass on audit logging gaps across API gateway / auth / console / billing / runtime. Found a few classes of issues: missing actor IDs on some billing events, resource_id absent for runtime execs, and schema-version not emitted by console actions. Need to triage and move to backlog.
matt: Can you paste 1-2 concrete examples? I can take gateway+auth if it's small.
 aisha: Sure — snippet from billing pipeline last week (redacted):
 ```
 { event: "invoice.updated", amount: 1200, user_email: "redacted", // no user_id
   request_id: "req_83jf" }
 ```
 And runtime exec log:
 ```
 { event: "runtime.exec_start", image: "rdw/worker:stable", trace_id: "t-8e2" } // no resource_id, no actor
 ```
devon: FYI customer evidence validation failed in sandbox: customers expect `kms.key_change` events to include key_id, change_type, and actor.id. Our KMS integration only emits key name and a description string.
olivia: Can we agree on minimal audited-event acceptance criteria? Proposal: [actor.id, actor.type, action, resource.id, resource.type, before, after (if applicable), request_id, trace_id, outcome, schema_version]. Keeps validation deterministic for customers.
audit-bot: automated-check: schema_version missing in 23/120 sampled console events (see https://go/reports/audit-sampling)
indra: Two quick constraints: 1) we must not leak PII in before/after snapshots, 2) schema changes should be backward compatible for 90 days. Suggest v1 -> v1.1 with optional fields, then v2 with required fields after migration.
matt: I'll grab gateway+auth. Quick win: inject actor.id from token introspect at gateway layer for all auth-related events. If token introspect is slow we can add async enrichment.
aisha: Thanks. For backlog triage, propose we create swimlanes: API-gateway, Auth, Console UX, Billing, Runtime. Each lane needs: owner, checklist (acceptance criteria above), sample events, validation job, ETA.
olivia: I'll own Console UX swimlane. I'll start with an audit discovery run this afternoon to map all console endpoints and which events they emit.
devon: I'll take Billing. Plan: add user_id (resolve from email hash if necessary), add invoice.resource_id where applicable, and add schema_version header in events.
indra: Runtime is noisy. For resource_id we need to decide canonical resource model (container id vs job id). I'll draft mapping for next sync. Also propose a small e2e validation harness that replays requests and validates emitted events for the acceptance checklist.
aisha: Example e2e check (simple curl-based smoke):
 ```sh
 # trigger create job
 curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" https://staging.api.redwood/run -d '{"image":"rdw/worker:staging"}'
 # validate event in audit-sink (pseudo)
 jq '.event=="runtime.exec_start" and .resource.id != null and .actor.id != null' < last_audit.json
 ```
matt: ETA: I'll have gateway+auth PR ready by EOD Wednesday. Will add unit tests for token enrichment and an integration test against local audit-sink.
devon: Billing ETA: end of next week, need help defining safe masking rules for before/after snapshots.
olivia: Console ETA: 3 business days for discovery + follow-up PR early next week.
indra: Runtime ETA: spike tomorrow (1d), mapping doc by Friday, change PR following that.
aisha: Action items: 1) create backlog tickets under SEC/AUDIT with swimlane label 2) owners add sample events to ticket 3) devs add schema_version and run audit-bot sampling until coverage >= 95% per lane. I'll spin up the tickets after this thread.
matt: One question: for older events in S3, do we plan to backfill schema_version? Or only forward-compat? Backfill may be expensive.
aisha: We'll do forward-compat only. Backfill only for high-value customer evidence requests — we'll handle case-by-case with a migration plan.
audit-bot: note: queued sampling job created (job_id: js-4401). Will post fail rate updates in #eng-security daily.
olivia: tagging @support for any customer requests that need evidence while we roll this out.
indra: small nit: add trace_id to all emits if not present. Helps correlate across services.
aisha: Agreed. Final: owners list: matt (gateway/auth), devon (billing), olivia (console), indra (runtime). I'll assign tickets and ping for weekly checkins. Thanks all :thumbsup:
